detail: Mercedes grew from 6 cars in 2013 to 7 in 2014. HWA ran 5 cars and Mücke ran 2.
Mücke ran Juncadella and Petrov under the Petronas name. Month taken from the article date.
The 2014 grid had 23 cars: Audi 8 and BMW 8 and Mercedes 7. Only Wikipedia checked for the total.
ART Grand Prix joined as the third Mercedes team with 2 cars for Paffett and Auer. Announced at the Mercedes Stars and Cars event in Stuttgart.
Mercedes went back to 8 cars. HWA ran 4 and Mücke 2 and ART 2.

team: Silberpfeil Energy Mercedes-AMG / gooix Original-Teile Mercedes-AMG
detail: HWA cars raced under sponsor team names. The Petronas team was still run by Mücke and Euronics/BWT by ART. So not all Mercedes squads were HWA in 2015.
The 2015 grid had 24 cars with 8 per make. Only Wikipedia checked for the total.

team: Mercedes-AMG Team ART / HWA I / HWA II / Mücke
detail: Mercedes teams used neutral names in 2016. ART and Mücke kept 2 cars each and HWA ran 4. Only Wikipedia checked.
The grid dropped from 24 to 18 cars with 6 per make. DTM first said this was possible on 2016-09-17 (date from Wikipedia).
Last season was 2016. Left when Mercedes cut to 6 cars all run by HWA. ART focused on junior single seaters.
Last season was 2016. Mercedes with Mücke since 2005 ended the DTM work but kept it in Formula 3.

team: Mercedes-AMG Motorsport BWT / Mercedes me / SILBERPFEIL Energy
detail: All 6 Mercedes cars were run by HWA in 3 teams of 2.
Mercedes went from 8 cars to 6.
Last season was 2016. MTEK moved to prepare the BMW GTE car for the 2018 WEC.
Last season was 2016. Schnitzer moved to GT racing only.
BMW went from 8 cars to 6. RMG and RBM ran them.
RMR means Reinhold Mampaey Racing. It is a shared crew from RMG and RBM for 2 cars (Glock and Blomqvist in 2017). It was not a new operator. Exact release date not confirmed.
Last season was 2016. Abt went from 4 cars in 2 teams to 2 cars in 1 team.
Audi went from 8 cars to 6. Abt and Phoenix and Rosberg ran 2 each.
Last season was 2018. Mercedes left for Formula E. Motorsport.com shows 2017-07-24 and Wikipedia cites it as 2017-07-25.

Aston Martin Vantage DTM took the Mercedes slot. Licensed by Aston Martin but not a works team. HWA built and ran the cars in a joint venture. Announced 2018-10-11 (motorsport.com page edited 2018-10-12).
R-Motorsport ran 4 cars. The engine was the HWA AFR Turbo 2.0 and not an Aston Martin unit (engine name from Wikipedia).
WRT became the first Audi customer team with 2 cars. Audi had 6 factory cars and 2 customer cars.
The 2019 grid had 18 regular cars: Audi 8 and BMW 6 and Aston Martin 4. Super GT guests at Hockenheim not counted. Only Wikipedia checked for the total.
Last season was 2019. The team split from engine builder HWA and then said DTM no longer fit its plans.
Aston Martin was gone from the grid after 2019. Aston Martin said it had no plan to be a works supplier.
ART returned as a BMW customer team with 1 car for Kubica. Sponsor was Orlen.
BMW had 7 cars: 6 factory cars and 1 ART customer car.
WRT added a third car for Habsburg. Audi had 9 cars: 6 factory and 3 WRT.
The 2020 grid had 16 cars: Audi 9 and BMW 7. Only Wikipedia checked for the total.

team: Audi Sport Team Abt Sportsline / Phoenix / Rosberg / WRT
detail: Last season was 2020. Audi left the DTM to focus on Formula E and customer racing.

Last season was 2020. The Class 1 rules ended and DTM moved to GT3. BMW ended the RBM works deal and moved RMG to M4 GT3 development. No single exit date found. Berger said on 2020-08-27 BMW was unlikely to stay.
